title: A simple generation flow
steps: Enter a city, a state and a cartoon count. Generate saves the request before production starts.
Dated sources guide the subject. The writer and reviewer revise the caption and matching TV and chalkboard ideas.
The RTX 4090 creates TV art. The compositor preserves the room and matching cast, then adds chalk and dialogue.
Progress reports completed stages, not a time estimate. Finished images appear with downloads and source records.

title: The system behind the screen
steps: GitHub holds the code and selected art. Vercel serves the website and authenticated request endpoints.
The database retains the queue and recovery checkpoints. Private storage holds generated images and evidence.
Requests wait when the PC is offline or its GPU is busy. The latest approved cast still awaits activation in the scheduled worker.
A dedicated always-on GPU can replace the PC. Monitoring and a tested recovery process remain essential.

title: Print size changes the detail
body:
The source is 1024 x 1536 pixels. Enlarging the picture does not create new detail.

The website exports exact-size PDFs on Letter or A4. Use Actual size in the print dialog and confirm the publication’s requirements.
